reader_summary.headline: Edward Chancellor joins Kai Wu on the latest episode of the Intangible Economy to discuss what financial history and capital cycle theory can teach investors about today’s AI boom...
reader_summary.overview: Edward Chancellor joins Kai Wu on the latest episode of the Intangible Economy to discuss what financial history and capital cycle theory can teach investors about today’s AI boom.. They explore why transformative technologies can still produce terrible investor returns, how overinvestment develops, where anti-bubbles may be forming.
